title: Impeller Type Classifier
description: Ten written impeller descriptions, shuffled, each sorted once into one of six bins (backward inclined, forward curved, mixed flow, axial fixed pitch, axial adjustable pitch, axial reversible), with feedback, a first-attempt score and an unscored review pile.
creator: Twin City Fan
subject: centrifugal impeller
axial impeller
mixed flow impeller
backward inclined impeller
forward curved impeller
fixed pitch impeller
adjustable pitch impeller
fiberglass axial impeller
reversible impeller
rights: Copyright 2026 Twin City Fan. All rights reserved.

educational.audience: Adult professional development: new application engineers, sales staff, representatives and facilities staff
learningObjectives: The learner will classify written descriptions of impellers into the impeller types named in this chapter, with at least 8 of 10 correct on the first attempt.

accessibility.notes: describe() text (fallback mode); every verdict, new card and the summary announced through FP.announce (aria-live); ✓/✗ glyphs and solid/dashed borders pair with colour on the card and on every placed chip; keys 1-6 place the card and Enter goes to the next; every button is reachable with Tab; bin buttons wrap inside the canvas at 320 px.

controls.label: Six bin buttons
controls.purpose: Place the card (keys 1-6); one scored placement

controls.label: Redo review pile
controls.purpose: Place the misplaced cards again, not scored

controls.label: Start over
controls.purpose: Reshuffle all ten cards and clear the score

rules: Each card has exactly one correct bin
Cards are judged on the first placement only for the score
Ten cards in shuffled order; the review pile does not change the score
Mastery 8 of 10 on the first attempt
limitations: Only the impeller types covered in Chapter 8 are bins; airfoil, backward curved and radial types are in Chapter 9

sources: FanPedia PDF p. 31: centrifugal impeller captions
FanPedia PDF pp. 6 and 32: mixed flow impeller
FanPedia PDF pp. 33-35: axial impeller types marked fixed or adjustable; fixed pitch cast or fabricated
FanPedia PDF p. 41: reversible impeller standard and reverse flow

pedagogical.teachingStrategy: Classify new descriptions by defining features, committing to a bin before feedback, with an unscored review pile
keyQuestions: Where does the air go: outward, straight through, or partway?
Do the blade tips point with rotation or trail it?
Can the blade angle be reset, and does the impeller run in two flow modes?
commonMisconceptions: Many narrow blades always means forward curved
Any impeller in a tubular housing is axial
Adjustable pitch means the blades can be changed while the fan runs
Fiberglass impellers are always fixed pitch
assessmentOpportunities: First-attempt score shown as 'First-attempt score: n of 10'; mastery is 8 of 10 on the first attempt.
